description.zh:
网关规格。取值范围：

- Basic：基础型。

- Standard：标准型。

- Enhanced：增强型。

- Advanced：性能型。
description.en:
The gateway class. Valid values:

- Basic
- Standard
- Enhanced
- Advanced

title.zh: 部署一个按量付费的网关

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

- 仅支持按量付费的云上文件网关。

- 仅支持部署状态为已初始化（Initialized）的云上文件网关。

- 部署完成后，您可以调用DescribeGateway接口查询网关状态，当状态为运行中（Running）时表示网关部署完成。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, note the following:

- This operation supports only pay-as-you-go cloud-based file gateways.
- You can deploy only cloud-based file gateways that are in the Initialized status.
- After the gateway is deployed, you can call the DescribeGateway operation to query the status of the gateway. The gateway is successfully deployed if its status is Running.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw deploy-gateway --gateway-id gw-0001xv7je3580031y000 --gateway-class Basic --region cn-hangzhou
